name: Quickcreator Agent
author: Quickcreator

sections.description:
Quickcreator Agent is the official WordPress plugin that seamlessly connects your WordPress site to QuickCreator Agent, enabling AI-driven SEO content creation and direct publishing to your WordPress site.

Key Features

  • Easy Integration: Connect your WordPress site to QuickCreator Agent in minutes
  • AI-Powered Content Creation: Leverage QuickCreator’s AI technology to generate SEO-optimized blog content
  • Direct Publishing: Publish articles directly to WordPress from QuickCreator’s Content Editor
  • Account Management: Simple account binding and unbinding process
  • SEO Optimization: Create highly rankable content using QuickCreator’s trusted guidelines
  • Free Plugin: Completely free WordPress plugin with no hidden costs

Easy Setup

Getting started is quick and easy:

  1. Install and activate the Quickcreator Agent plugin
  2. Connect your WordPress site to your QuickCreator Agent account
  3. Create SEO-optimized content using QuickCreator’s AI-powered editor
  4. Publish directly to WordPress with one click

Third-Party Services

This plugin integrates with QuickCreator Agent, a third-party service that provides:

  • Account binding and unbinding
  • Blog content generation
  • Export of blog content to WordPress

Service Information:
* Front-end app: https://agent.quickcreator.io
* API: https://api.quickcreator.io/ai-blog-writer-service
* Documentation: https://docs.quickcreator.io/docs/Integrations/wordpress-plugin
* Terms of Use: https://quickcreator.io/terms-of-service
* Privacy Policy: https://quickcreator.io/privacy

Legal Disclaimer: By using this plugin, you agree to the terms and policies of QuickCreator Agent. It is your responsibility to ensure that your use of these services complies with all applicable laws and regulations.

Support

Need help? We’re here for you:

  • Visit our website and reach out via chat
  • Email us at support@quickcreator.io
  • Join our Facebook Group
  • Follow us on LinkedIn and YouTube
sections.faq:
How do I connect my WordPress site to QuickCreator Agent?

After installing and activating the plugin, navigate to the plugin settings page in your WordPress admin panel. Follow the instructions to connect your site to your QuickCreator Agent account.

Do I need a QuickCreator Agent account to use this plugin?

Yes, you need a QuickCreator Agent account to use this plugin. You can sign up at https://agent.quickcreator.io.

Can I publish content directly from QuickCreator to WordPress?

Yes! Once connected, you can create content in QuickCreator’s Content Editor and publish it directly to your WordPress site without any manual copying or pasting.

What WordPress editors does this plugin support?

The plugin supports multiple WordPress editors including Gutenberg, Classic Editor, and Elementor.

Is this plugin free?

Yes, the Quickcreator Agent WordPress plugin is completely free to use.
